deploy-bot: [deploy] Started rollout inference-scaler v2 -> v3 in prod at 2026-03-17T10:12:12Z. Canary 10% on nodepool-gpu-1. CI: all checks passed.

amanda (oncall): Pager — high 5xx rate alert from frontend->inference. Noticing spike exactly after the canary started.

pagerduty-bot: PAGER: PROD - High error rate (5xx) on inference-api. Current: 12% of requests failing, spike at 10:14 UTC. Escalation: p0.

amanda (oncall): I'm on it, pinging @raj to take over oncall.

raj (sre): joining. Seen the alert. Can you drop logs from the canary pods?

amanda (oncall): grabbing logs from pod inference-scaler-canary-7f8c

amanda (oncall): ```kubectl -n prod logs inference-scaler-canary-7f8c -c scaler```

amanda (oncall): shows repeated liveness failures: "health check timeout waiting for /ready (500ms)" then crashloop.

maria (eng): that new healthcheck change added a readiness probe that checks `/metrics/queue` which errors if the node is draining (empty socket) — suspecting transient failure on node drain.

raj (sre): checking node status for nodepool-gpu-1 nodes that got the canary.

raj (sre): ```kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-1 -o wide```

raj (sre): One node is in Draining state (cordoned) by recent maintenance. Kubelet returned NotReady briefly. Canary landed on a node that's being drained -> readiness fails -> pod crashloops. HPA observed sudden drop in ready pods and started scaling other replicas aggressively.

sre-lead: tl;dr: rollout landed on partially drained capacity -> healthcheck too strict -> crashloops -> HPA noise -> overall cluster pressure -> 5xxs.

raj (sre): Immediate mitigations: 1) Pause rollout 2) Flip kill-switch feature flag for scaler_v3 3) Undo rollout if needed 4) Cordon the draining node to prevent more scheduling.

amanda (oncall): pausing rollout now via rollout pause.
amanda (oncall): ```kubectl -n prod rollout pause deploy/inference-scaler```

deploy-bot: Rollout paused successfully for deployment/inference-scaler (canary paused).

raj (sre): Flipping feature flag to disable v3 auto-enable. Using our configmap toggle so it's instant: ```kubectl -n prod patch cm feature-flags -p '{"data":{"scaler_v3_enabled":"false"}}'```

infra-bot: ConfigMap updated: feature-flags/feature-flags patched.

maria (eng): Confirmed application reads flag; canary pods started settling after flag flip but a few remain crashlooping due to node being drained.

raj (sre): Undoing rollout to v2 to be safe.

raj (sre): ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-scaler --to-revision=2```

deploy-bot: Rollout undo initiated -> waiting for stableReplicaSet.

raj (sre): Also cordoning that node to avoid new pods landing there: ```kubectl cordon ip-10-0-18-45```

amanda (oncall): Customer impact: frontend reports ~8% of requests failing for ~12min window before mitigation, affects ~3% of customers (largest impacted customers see degraded latency and some request timeouts). Notified CS to prepare comms.

customer-success: Thanks, will monitor and stand by for an incident summary.

raj (sre): Monitoring rolling back and pod status. If undo succeeds, we'll see ready pod count return to normal and HPA stabilize.

raj (sre): Current metrics: 5xx down from 12% -> 2.1% after flag flip and undo in progress. P95 latency improved ~300ms.

maria (eng): Postmortem notes to include: 1) don't land strict healthchecks that fail on node drain 2) ensure canary scheduling avoids nodes in NotReady/Draining 3) HPA should have a buffer and cooldown to avoid cascading scale events 4) feature-flag kill-switch test coverage to flip under load.

sre-lead: Good. For immediate follow-ups: - Add a pre-scheduling predicate for canary label to avoid nodes in 'Unschedulable' past X mins - Add probe grace period for readiness to tolerate transient NotReady during drain - Add HPA stabilization window increase for this deployment - Add runbook step to cordon nodes when a canary lands on a draining node.

amanda (oncall): Handing back to raj for post-incident tracking. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

raj (sre): I'll own the incident ticket, will open a suppression for alerts during the rollback window and coordinate a detailed postmortem with eng. Tagging @maria to lead root cause investigation for the healthcheck change.

maria (eng): Ack. I'll start a PR with the readiness probe rollback and add tests.

infra-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-314 opened and assigned to raj.

sre-lead: Closing notes before we fully resolve: Confirm rollback stabilizes for 30m, then uncordon node and observe. If stable, mark incident resolved.

raj (sre): Monitoring — current stable replicas=5. Will update incident ticket with timeline and mitigation steps.

amanda (oncall): last check: error rate back to baseline ~0.3% at 10:27 UTC. Marking initial mitigation complete.

maria (eng): I'll draft the postmortem and proposed config changes.

raj (sre): thanks all.
